description:
The calculator sends the form to /api/emi and draws the answer. Expected
  EMIs, totals and calendar-year schedules come from the suite's own
  amortisation (tests/utils/emi.ts), so the UI cannot agree with itself.

description:
Three screens repeat part of the address back to the user: the report's search box, the
  report's note about a bad page number, and the loan-not-found message. Each is a reflected
  XSS sink (OWASP WSTG-INJT-01, WSTG-CLNT-01). The app must escape the text itself; its
  Content-Security-Policy is the second line of defence, so these scenarios also require that
  the policy had nothing to block. Every other LoanLens UI scenario that renders a page fails on a CSP
  violation too.

elements.name: The report's search box shows markup from the URL as text and runs none of it

the page should show "" as plain text
no element should have been built from ""
no browser dialog should have opened
the Content-Security-Policy should not have had to block anything
